declared_exclusions.item: Full 14-field claim_contract evidence shape for tension factor cells.
declared_exclusions.reason: Record s.3 states TENSION rows adopt the full claim_contract 'whole', but check_lt_r1.py's own arms (core_factors) only test status + instrument-pattern, and the planted tension factor cells carry the same 5-field evidence shape as every other cell (instrument, blind_spot, locator, vintage, denominator). The schema uses one uniform $defs.cell throughout rather than a second, stricter cell definition for tensions only, since no acceptance criterion this round distinguishes them and inventing an untested second shape would be schema surface the record does not currently exercise.
